abstract_sentences.text: Diffusion language models have emerged as a powerful alternative to autoregressive models, enabling fast inference through more flexible and parallel generation paths.

This flexibility of sampling is unlocked by new engineered sampling strategies, or planners, that select more favorable generation paths by iteratively planning—versus uniformly at random—where to denoise along the sequence.
However, by modifying the reverse paths via planning, planners create an irrevocable mismatch between the uniformly random denoising paths assumed during training and planning-based inference.

In this paper, we systematically investigate the mismatch of discrete diffusion training and inference under planning and theoretically prove that the standard discrete diffusion training evidence lower bound (ELBO) does not accurately describe a denoiser that uses a non-uniform planner.

evidence.anchor: standard ... ELBO does not accurately describe

abstract_sentences.text: To address this gap, we derive a new planned evidence lower bound (P-ELBO) that incorporates planner-based reverse dynamics directly into the training objective.
Using the P-ELBO, we introduce Planner Aware Path Learning (PAPL), a novel training scheme that aligns training and inference under a planned denoiser.
PAPL is implemented as a simple yet effective modification to the standard masked discrete diffusion loss, making it widely applicable and easy to adopt.

Empirically, we show PAPL delivers consistent gains across domains, including a 40% relative improvement in protein sequences, improved text generation with up to a 4× relative MAUVE gain, and 23% relative improvement in code generation HumanEval pass@10.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 用 path-wise KL 把 planner 的 reverse dynamics 纳入 ELBO；Prop.3.1 证明 uniform objective 对 greedy inference 的失配，Prop.3.2 给出 P-ELBO，soft self-planning 与 Eq.(7) 得到 PAPL，三域实验检验质量与路径对齐。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留核心变量、Eq.(1)/(4)–(7)、E1/E2 含义、Algorithm 1、三域 setup/主表、Fig.3–4 和 training-overhead boundary。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: KL/Markov/CTMC proofs、P2 remasking、implementation hyperparameters、planner ablations、近似 loss、HumanEval failures 和调参建议集中在 p.17–46。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Fig.1 路径示意、最小 L=2 反例、Eq.(7) 一行 weighted CE、Table 7 approximation decomposition 共同把机制、理论与实现连起来。
final_judgment.largest_gap: PAPL 是多步 surrogate；pure-PAPL instability、P2 full-support 不可行、缺少 seed/区间和 Table 3 Oracle length 行，使宽泛的 applicability/no-overhead 与 causal attribution 需要收窄。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 当 inference 使用训练分布之外的路径选择器时，先将选择器写入 transition 和 bound，再分别标出 detach、sampling、interpolation 等 surrogate，并用最小反例及 approximation ablation 检验每步误差。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于 Markov path 可写、目标 reference path 可定义且 planner probability 可评估的生成模型；大规模 subset/remasking、不可微 external state 或无法采样 reference path 时只能迁移诊断框架。
